newsitem.title: MEXICO: Comerci July same-store sales up 7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Comerci July same-store sales up 7 pct.

text.p: Same-store sales posted by Mexican retailer Controladora Comercial Mexicana (Comerci) in July were up seven percent from year-ago figures, the company said.
"Same-store sales in July rose by seven percent compared to last year, and by 4.7 percent for the year to date," said a Comerci director, who declined to be named.
The director added that it was too early to determine the impact of an annual promotional campaign held in July, but he estimated it would be positive.
